title: How AI Agents Are Reshaping Work in 2026

slides.heading: How AI Agents Are Reshaping Work in 2026
slides.body: From task assistants to autonomous collaborators — the workplace is transforming faster than ever

slides.heading: What Is an AI Agent?
slides.body: An AI agent is more than a chatbot — it can plan multi-step tasks, use tools, browse the web, write and run code, and take real-world actions. Unlike one-shot Q&A, agents operate in loops until a goal is achieved.

slides.heading: From Assistant to Colleague
slides.body: In 2026, AI agents are embedded in workflows as persistent team members. They attend meetings, summarize decisions, file tickets, send follow-ups, and track project status — all without being asked twice.

slides.heading: The Software Dev Revolution
slides.body: Coding agents now write tests, fix bugs, review pull requests, and deploy features autonomously. Developers increasingly act as architects and reviewers rather than line-by-line coders, multiplying output by 5–10x.

slides.heading: Knowledge Work Gets a Copilot
slides.body: Lawyers, analysts, and researchers use agents to draft documents, synthesize hundreds of sources, and flag risks. Hours of manual research compress into minutes while accuracy improves with cited sources.

slides.heading: Customer Service, Reimagined
slides.body: AI agents now handle end-to-end customer resolution — pulling account data, issuing refunds, escalating edge cases, and learning from each interaction. Human agents focus on empathy-heavy or novel situations.

slides.heading: Multi-Agent Systems
slides.body: The biggest shift is agents coordinating with other agents. A 'manager' agent breaks down a goal, delegates to specialist sub-agents (research, writing, coding), then assembles results. Complex projects complete overnight.

slides.heading: The Trust & Control Challenge
slides.body: More autonomy means higher stakes. Organizations are building 'human-in-the-loop' guardrails, audit trails, and permission systems so agents act within defined boundaries — preventing costly or irreversible mistakes.

slides.heading: New Skills for the Agent Era
slides.body: The most valuable workers in 2026 are 'agent orchestrators' — people who define goals clearly, evaluate agent output critically, and design workflows that blend human judgment with AI execution.

slides.heading: The Future Is Collaborative
slides.body: AI agents aren't replacing workers — they're amplifying them. Those who learn to work alongside agents will lead the next era of productivity. The question isn't if your workflow will change, but how fast.
